intro: Dubai rewards visitors with big sights, old creek districts and easy desert escapes. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro Red and Green lines link the airport, Downtown and Marina; fares AED 3-7.50 with a Silver nol card.
Nol Silver card costs AED 25 with AED 19 balance; a Red ticket suits up to 5 rides.
Buses cover the rest of the city; tap out at the end of every ride.
Taxis are easy to flag; Careem and Uber both work in Dubai.
Driving is common; rent a car with an International Driving Permit.
Walking is fine in Marina and Deira but hard in summer heat; abras cross the creek for AED 1-2.

burj-khalifa.name: Burj Khalifa
burj-khalifa.price_text: ≈ AED 169+ for At the Top, levels 124–125; higher decks cost more. Book online for lower prices
burj-khalifa.hours: Daily, roughly 08:30–23:00; sunset slots sell out first
burj-khalifa.tip: Book a sunset slot online days ahead and arrive 30 minutes early for security.

dubai-mall.name: Dubai Mall
dubai-mall.price_text: Free to enter; individual attractions and shops charge
dubai-mall.tip: It is huge. Pick one or two zones and use the mall map app to avoid walking in circles.

palm-jumeirah.name: Palm Jumeirah
palm-jumeirah.price_text: Free to drive or taxi across; attractions on the island charge
palm-jumeirah.hours: Always accessible; The View at The Palm has timed slots
palm-jumeirah.tip: See the palm shape from above at The View at The Palm, or ride the monorail for a cheap look.

dubai-fountain.name: Dubai Fountain
dubai-fountain.price_text: Free to watch from the promenade
dubai-fountain.hours: Evening shows every 30 minutes, roughly 18:00–23:00; times change by season
dubai-fountain.tip: Stand on the Dubai Mall waterfront or book a lake-side restaurant table for a clear view.

burj-al-arab.name: Burj Al Arab
burj-al-arab.price_text: Viewing from outside is free; inside access needs a restaurant or tour booking (prices vary, check on the day)
burj-al-arab.hours: Exterior viewable anytime; inside only with a booking
burj-al-arab.tip: Best free view is from Jumeirah Beach or the Madinat Jumeirah walkways at sunset.

museum-future.name: Museum of the Future
museum-future.price_text: ≈ AED 149 adult; child rates lower. Book online
museum-future.tip: Timed tickets sell out. Book online and go early to avoid queues.

dubai-frame.name: The Dubai Frame
dubai-frame.price_text: ≈ AED 50 adult; child rates lower. Check current price online
dubai-frame.tip: The glass sky bridge gives old-Dubai views on one side and new Dubai on the other. Go near sunset.

al-fahidi.name: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood
al-fahidi.price_text: Free to walk; small museums and cafés charge
al-fahidi.hours: Lanes always open; museums roughly 08:00–18:00, closed some days
al-fahidi.tip: Walk the wind-tower lanes in the morning, then cool off in a courtyard café.

adventureland-sharjah.name: Adventureland, Sharjah
adventureland-sharjah.price_text: Ticket prices vary by ride pass; check on the day
adventureland-sharjah.hours: Roughly afternoon to late evening; hours vary by season
adventureland-sharjah.tip: It is an indoor family amusement park in Sharjah. Confirm opening hours before you travel out.

dubai-aquarium.name: Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo
dubai-aquarium.price_text: ≈ AED 120+ for the basic tunnel pass; combos cost more
dubai-aquarium.tip: The big tank is visible free from the mall walkway. Pay only if you want the tunnel and zoo.

creek-abra.name: Dubai Creek Abra
creek-abra.price_text: ≈ AED 1 per crossing on the public abra; private tours cost more
creek-abra.hours: Public abra runs most of the day into the evening
creek-abra.tip: Take the public abra between Bur Dubai and Deira for a one-dirham creek crossing.

gold-souk.name: Dubai Gold Souk
gold-souk.price_text: Free to browse; you pay for what you buy
gold-souk.tip: Prices are by weight plus making charge. Compare a few shops and ask for the day rate.

marina-dhow.name: Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise
marina-dhow.price_text: ≈ AED 120–250 depending on dinner and boat; check inclusions
marina-dhow.tip: Confirm pickup, dinner and drinks are included before booking.

dubai-opera.name: Dubai Opera
dubai-opera.price_text: Ticket prices vary by show; check the programme
dubai-opera.hours: Box office and shows in the evening; check schedule
dubai-opera.tip: Book ahead for popular shows and arrive early for the Downtown views.

dubai-parks.name: Dubai Parks and Resorts
dubai-parks.price_text: ≈ AED 295+ per park; multi-park passes cost more
dubai-parks.hours: Daily, roughly 11:00–20:00; hours vary by season
dubai-parks.tip: It is far out near the Abu Dhabi border. Plan a full day and check park hours first.

img-worlds.name: IMG Worlds of Adventure
img-worlds.hours: Daily, roughly 12:00–20:00; check on the day
img-worlds.tip: It is a large indoor park, good for hot days. Book online for discounts.

jbr-beach.name: JBR Beach
jbr-beach.price_text: Free public beach; sunbeds and watersports charge
jbr-beach.hours: Open daily; swimming usually until evening
jbr-beach.tip: The beach has showers and a running track. Go early morning or sunset for cooler air.

kite-beach.name: Kite Beach
kite-beach.price_text: Free public beach; food trucks and watersports charge
kite-beach.tip: Good for families and food trucks. Bring your own towel and shade.

legoland-dubai.name: Legoland Dubai
legoland-dubai.tip: Best for younger children. Check height rules and park hours before booking.

motiongate.name: Motiongate Dubai
motiongate.tip: Movie-themed rides for teens and adults. Plan a full day and check hours.

real-madrid-world.name: Real Madrid World
real-madrid-world.price_text: Ticket prices vary; check on the day
real-madrid-world.hours: Daily, roughly 11:00–20:00; check on the day
real-madrid-world.tip: Football-themed rides at Dubai Parks and Resorts. Confirm opening days before you go.

sharjah-islamic-museum.name: Sharjah Museum of Islamic Civilization
sharjah-islamic-museum.hours: Roughly Sat–Thu 09:00–17:00, Fri shorter; closed some days
sharjah-islamic-museum.tip: It is in Sharjah, a separate emirate. Allow travel time and check opening days.

spice-souk.name: Spice Souk, Deira
spice-souk.price_text: Free to browse; you pay for what you buy
spice-souk.tip: Walk here from the abra landing and bargain politely. Buy spices by weight.

al-seef-walk.name: Al Seef waterfront walk
al-seef-walk.price_text: Free to walk; cafés and shops charge
al-seef-walk.hours: Open daily; liveliest in the evening
al-seef-walk.tip: A restored creek-side promenade near Al Fahidi. Good for an evening stroll and photos.

desert-safari.name: Desert safari with BBQ dinner
desert-safari.price_text: ≈ AED 200–400 shared, hotel pickup included; check inclusions
desert-safari.tip: Dune drive, camel ride and camp dinner. Confirm pickup, dinner and VAT are included.

madinat-view.name: Madinat Jumeirah waterways
madinat-view.price_text: Free to walk; abra rides and restaurants charge
madinat-view.tip: A calm canal walk with the best free view of Burj Al Arab. Go at sunset.

marina-walk.name: Dubai Marina promenade walk
marina-walk.price_text: Free to walk; cafés and boats charge
marina-walk.tip: Walk the full loop at night for the skyline lights, then eat at JBR.

styles.label: Shopping

stays.why: Walk to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall; Metro Red Line on the doorstep.
Beach and promenade at the door; Metro and tram nearby for the rest of the city.
Cheapest beds, gold and spice souks, creek abras; Metro Green Line links Downtown.
Beach hotels and quiet streets; taxis needed for most sights.

food: Try Emirati dishes: machboos rice, harees and luqaimat dumplings with date syrup.
Cheap eats in Deira and Bur Dubai: shawarma, karak tea and Indian cafeterias, roughly AED 10–30 a meal.
Fish and grills along Jumeirah Beach Road; book ahead for weekend brunch in hotels.
Alcohol is served only in licensed hotel bars and restaurants. Dress modestly in souks and malls.
During Ramadan, daytime eating is restricted in public; many hotels serve iftar buffets in the evening.
more_time: Swap a mall afternoon for a desert safari: dune drive and dinner, roughly AED 150–350, book a licensed operator.
Take an abra across the creek (AED 1–2) and wander the Al Fahidi historic lanes and the souks.
Add a day trip to Abu Dhabi or Hatta; check bus and tour prices on the day.
